legend: Cindy has started exercising regularly and doing physical conditioning. Inspired by her favorite anime series, she decided to clean up a beach full of trash that people had been treating as a dumping site for their junk. It simultaneously functions as strength training, and a way for her to do some good for society!

There are N$$$N$$$ pieces of junk in a single line. From left to right, the i$$$i$$$th piece of junk has a height of Hi$$$H_i$$$ and a weight of Wi$$$W_i$$$; it is guaranteed that the heights of each object are distinct. Cindy wishes to sort the junk in increasing order of height. The only operation that Cindy can do is to pick up two adjacent objects and swap their positions in the line. Since the objects can be heavy, the total energy that Cindy expends is the product of the weights of the two objects. Formally, Cindy can swap the positions of the i$$$i$$$th and (i+1)$$$(i+1)$$$th objects, and doing so costs Wi×Wi+1$$$W_i \times W_{i+1}$$$ units of energy.
What is the minimum amount of energy that Cindy needs to expend in order to sort the junk in ascending order of height?
input: The first line of input contains a single integer N$$$N$$$, the number of pieces of junk.
The second line of input contains N$$$N$$$ space-separated integers H1,H2,…,HN$$$H_1, H_2, \dots, H_N$$$, where Hi$$$H_i$$$ is the height of the i$$$i$$$th piece of junk.
The third line of input contains N$$$N$$$ space-separated integers W1,W2,…,WN$$$W_1, W_2, \dots, W_N$$$, where Wi$$$W_i$$$ is the weight of the i$$$i$$$th piece of junk.
output: Output a single integer, the minimum amount of energy that Cindy needs to expend to sort the junk in increasing order of height.
It is recommended that Python users submit to PyPy for this problem.
It is guaranteed that Hi≠Hj$$$H_i \neq H_j$$$ for i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$.
All pieces of junk will have the same weight.
note: For the first sample test case, Cindy first swaps the objects of height 3$$$3$$$ and 1$$$1$$$, spending 4×5=20$$$4 \times 5 = 20$$$ energy. Then, she swaps the objects of height 3$$$3$$$ and 2$$$2$$$, spending 4×6=24$$$4 \times 6 = 24$$$ energy. The junk is now fully sorted in increasing order of height, and Cindy spent a total of 20+24=44$$$20+24 = 44$$$ energy.

legend.ai: 辛迪开始定期锻炼并进行体能训练。受到她最喜欢的动画系列启发，她决定清理一片堆满垃圾的海滩，人们一直把那里当作倾倒废品的场所。这既能进行力量训练，也能为社会做些好事！

有 N$$$N$$$ 件垃圾排成一行。从左到右，第 i$$$i$$$ 件垃圾的高度为 Hi$$$H_i$$$，重量为 Wi$$$W_i$$$；保证每件垃圾的高度各不相同。辛迪希望将这些垃圾按高度递增的顺序排列。辛迪唯一能进行的操作是拿起两个相邻的物体并交换它们在线中的位置。由于物体可能很重，辛迪消耗的总能量等于这两个物体重量的乘积。形式化地说，辛迪可以交换第 i$$$i$$$ 个和第 (i+1)$$$(i+1)$$$ 个物体的位置，这样做需要消耗 Wi×Wi+1$$$W_i \times W_{i+1}$$$ 单位的能量。
为了将垃圾按高度升序排列，辛迪最少需要消耗多少能量？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$，表示垃圾的数量。
输入的第二行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个由空格分隔的整数 H1,H2,…,HN$$$H_1, H_2, \dots, H_N$$$，其中 Hi$$$H_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 件垃圾的高度。
输入的第三行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个由空格分隔的整数 W1,W2,…,WN$$$W_1, W_2, \dots, W_N$$$，其中 Wi$$$W_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 件垃圾的重量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示 Cindy 为按高度递增顺序整理垃圾所需消耗的最小能量。
建议使用 Python 的用户使用 PyPy 提交本题。
保证对于 i≠j$$$i \neq j$$$，Hi≠Hj$$$H_i \neq H_j$$$。
所有废料的重量都相同。

note.ai: 对于第一个样例测试用例，Cindy 首先交换高度为 3$$$3$$$ 和 1$$$1$$$ 的物体，消耗 4×5=20$$$4 \times 5 = 20$$$ 点能量。然后，她交换高度为 3$$$3$$$ 和 2$$$2$$$ 的物体，消耗 4×6=24$$$4 \times 6 = 24$$$ 点能量。现在，废料已经按照高度递增的顺序完全排好，Cindy 总共消耗了 20+24=44$$$20+24 = 44$$$ 点能量。
